items: 🚀【Unmatched Performance & Gemini AI 2.0 Smart Assistant】The ZIOVO tablet undergoes a revolutionary upgrade, featuring a 2.0GHz high-performance processor and Android 15 OS(boasting enhanced security/privacy and ad elimination) . Experience lightning-fast app launches, ultra-responsive touch controls, and rock-solid system stability—delivering seamless performance at a price that outperforms premium tablets costing thousands.Gemini AI 2.0 stands out: 24/7 smart helper with voice control, real-time translation, and AI summarization. AI chat for resolving issues with remarkable efficiency.

"🎬【Widevine L1 & Eye-Care HD 10 Inch IPS Screen】 Widevine L1 certified to unlock HD streaming on Amazon Prime Video, YouTube, and more. Its 10.1-inch IPS display (1280*800) with Ultra HDR and Android 15 delivers vibrant colors, sharp contrasts, and wide viewing angles for an immersive cinematic experience. The blue light filter reduces eye strain during extended viewing, while dual stereo speakers, a 3.5mm audio jack, and USB support for lossless audio formats ensure audiophile-grade sound quality for movies, shows, and music."

🔋【8000mAh Large Capacity Battery + Dual Camera】Equipped with an 8000mAh battery, enjoy mixed use and perfect for all-day school, work, or travel. USB-C charging for enhanced portability. Optimized with Android 15’s dynamic performance framework, it intelligently balances power consumption for extended use. Capture moments with the 8MP rear camera or ace video meetings with the 5MP front camera.Face unlock adds convenience, keeping data secure without fumbling for passwords.

💾【Massive Storage + GMS Certified + Parental Controls】8GB+ 22GB Virtual Memory (30GB RAM total) + 128GB ROM handles multitasking effortlessly. Expandable to 1TB via MicroSD. GMS-certified for full access to 3M+ trusted apps on Google Play, including essential apps (Gmail, Microsoft Office,Instagram, Skype..). Plus, Kids Space offers age-appropriate apps for children.Parental controls let you manage screen time and block content—ideal for family sharing, with Gemini AI even helping kids with homework answers!

📶【Ultra-Stable Connectivity + Productivity Tools】Stay connected seamlessly with Dual-band 2.4G/5G WiFi minimizing network latency ensures fast and instant response. Bluetooth 5.0: support the 2Mbps transmission rate, powers lag-free audio，4x the range, and seamless multi-device connectivity for your tablet PC. Built-in GPS with offline Google Maps aids travel planning, or location-based apps. Boost efficiency with split-screen (note-taking + meetings) and screen recording (save lectures).

🎁【2-in-1 Computer Bundle + Perfect Gift】Comes with Lightweight Bluetooth keyboard, protective case, and mouse—easily switch from tablet to laptop for work/study. Features a sleek metal body in trendy hues (Lavender Mist, Glacier Blue, Carbon Fiber Black).Packed with premium features, it’s the top gift for Thanksgiving, Christmas, birthdays, Mother’s/Father’s Day—ideal for families, students, and pros. In addition, we provide you with two year of replacement service, as well as 24 hours of dedicated customer service and tablet technical support.
